answer: Noise token injection at the jetty: each agent's payout is salted with a token derived from the prior block hash, so identical sybil work yields divergent, unpredictable rewards. The tundra of blank identity space stays cold—no reusable proof schema survives, since any token minted for one block is worthless the next. A quill of signed randomness forces each fake identity to re-solve fresh, unshareable work per round. Break-even: farming 100 identities costs 100x the noise-reseed overhead, exceeding honest single-agent yield.
